author: Unity
description:
Unity 6.5 is here with 2D upgrades, graphics and shader improvements, core engine changes, platform updates, and more. 

In this video, we cover what’s new in Unity 6.5, including new 2D lighting and performance features, re-designed lighting and animation windows, Built-In Render Pipeline deprecation, Shader Graph updates, on-tile post-processing, CoreCLR-related scripting improvements, Android and iOS performance updates, and more. 

🔗 Unity 6.5 is a supported release. For more details and highlights, check-out our discussion post: https://on.unity.com/Unity6_5
🔗 Learn more and upgrade today: https://on.unity.com/6_5_Documentation
